title: Client operations by outcome
description: Per repository call, including background mine refreshes after writes. Separate write success from refresh failure.

title: Create outcomes
description: Terminal create repository calls. UI create_started counts entry intent and is not a request denominator.

title: Client operation failure %
description: All repository failures, including validation, auth and network. Zero means no counted failures; inspect traffic alongside it.

title: Client decode failures
description: Response decoding or domain mapping failed. Includes mine, get, create and update.

title: Client operation volume
description: Number of terminal repository operations over one hour. No traffic is not proof of health.

title: Create entry intent
description: Chooser versus feature intro. Compare to terminal creates as activity, not a cohort conversion rate.

title: Invite share actions
description: System share action handed off, not confirmed delivery.

title: Calendar outcomes
description: iOS added confirms save; Android opened only confirms editor launch. Unavailable falls back to .ics; cancelled is not a failure.

title: Client standing join successes
description: Confirmed standing room summary on a successful join. Not a link-attributed funnel.

title: Known standing join failures
description: Only failures attributable to a known standing code; unknown-code failures omit this attribute, so this is not a complete denominator.

title: Share requests by semantic outcome
description: Includes HTTP 200 unknown/archived responses. page, calendar and preview are separate surfaces; bots and repeat requests count.

title: Standing invite page responses
description: Page responses only, excluding preview crawlers and calendar requests. Not distinct people.

title: Unknown or archived page responses
description: Semantic unavailable responses even when HTTP status is 200. Expected expired links do not page the owner.

title: Standing joins by outcome
description: Known standing codes only. Lookup errors before attribution remain in generic HTTP telemetry.

title: Standing join request success %
description: Successful or already-joined requests / all attributable standing join requests. Request conversion, not share-to-player attribution.

title: Standing sitting materializations
description: created, reused and error. Existing live sittings can be reused without a new room.

title: Share request error %
description: Unexpected server errors / all share surface requests. Unknown/archived/invalid are semantic outcomes, not server errors.

title: Share request volume
description: All share surfaces over one hour. Inspect before interpreting error percentages.

title: Sessions taking a standing-table action
description: Unique sessions with create, open, share or calendar intent over a rolling hour. Aggregate count only; no identifiers shown. Not unique people, exposure or confirmed calendar saves.
